label: positive
title: Great way to save
text:
Back in the day, my bank used to have something called Christmas Club where the bank would automatically put your chosen amount from your checking to Christmas account, and in December you would have money saved up. That never worked for me because I always would up using it for other things.

I am now using my Amazon Gift Card as a Christmas Club. Every month I move a certain amount from my checking account to the card. The best part is, I can't use it anywhere but Amazon. So, I can't decide that I want to go out to a posh restaurant just for the hell of it, my money is safely at Amazon where I can't get it. That's a good thing, because I do most of my shopping at Amazon anyway, and now, I'll have "free" money to spend for Christmas, or save up for something my family really wants.
